record.reason: The paper defines persistent visual memory, context selection, layered indexes, and source-grounded evidence for continuously arriving video. Retrieval results are strong, but the contribution is an infrastructure/system model rather than a measured LLM inference-cost optimization.
record.title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence
